subject: latin
summary: Latin cards read cleanly: the question is short, the Latin passage attaches as a sharp page with its glossed words underlined, and the schemes do answer the question asked. The faults are in how scheme text was lifted: examiner slashes are left in ('small flasks/ and divided into three types / One for himself and us /'), sentences are cut mid-phrase into separate tick boxes with trailing semicolons, and one question ends in a dangling 'OR' with the alternative missing. The attached passage page also carries the alternative Section A translation task above the passage, so the Latin starts halfway down the page. Phone and desktop show the same content with no overflow; long short-note schemes make a long phone scroll.

issues.title: Question ends with a dangling 'OR'
issues.detail: Card 4 reads 'According to Cicero, what qualities should the ideal general have? OR' and stops. The alternative question after OR has been cut off, so it looks broken.
issues.suggested_fix: Either remove the trailing 'OR' or show the alternative as a second option with its own scheme.

issues.title: Examiner slashes left in scheme text
issues.detail: Card 1's single 14-mark point reads 'Wine is served in small flasks/ and divided into three types / One for himself and us / another for his lesser friends / and another for his and our freedmen/' including a trailing slash. The slashes are the examiner's mark divisions but no marks are shown per segment, so 14m is all-or-nothing.
issues.suggested_fix: Split at the slashes into separate rows with the marks each segment carries, or show them as a bulleted list inside one row.

issues.title: Scheme sentences chopped into fragments
issues.detail: Card 4 splits one list into four tick boxes with leftover punctuation: 'Qualities: valour;', 'knowledge of military affairs;', 'authority;', 'good fortune'. Card 2 splits one sentence into 'That the harmony in the marriage will be long lasting' and 'and even greater in the future'. Card 3 leaves trailing semicolons on most rows.
issues.suggested_fix: Strip the trailing semicolons and the 'Qualities:' prefix; start each row with a capital.

issues.title: Short-note scheme lacks grouping and clear marks
issues.detail: Card 3 lists eight rows for four options (Massilia and the treaty each spread over three rows) with no sub-headings, and ends with 'The examiner marks the first correct answers higher than the rest ((3+2) + (3+2))', which does not explain that it is two notes at 5 marks each. Card 5 puts both examples in one box with no marks.
issues.suggested_fix: Group rows under the four option names; state 'Any two notes, 5 marks each (3 + 2)'. Split card 5 into two rows of 5 marks.

issues.title: Attached passage page also shows the Section A translation task
issues.detail: The page for the Section B passage opens with 'A. Translate into Latin' and its full English paragraph; the Latin passage begins halfway down. The questions/vocabulary for the passage are below the fold of the first view.
issues.suggested_fix: Crop the page to start at 'B. Read the following passage'.

issues.title: Choice rubric shown above a single question
issues.detail: 'Answer any three of the five questions below. Each question carries ten marks.' appears above one question; there are no questions below.
issues.suggested_fix: Drop or reword the rubric on single-question cards.

good_examples.why: Clear question, right passage attached, two 4-mark points that add up to the total.
Question with quotation reads well and the scheme gives the two actions asked for.
